package postgres_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	plannerpostgres "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Root alone provisions and invokes this isolated real PostgreSQL test.
// Generated event envelopes are named ingress fixtures; they are not learner evidence proof.
func TestT20HybridDurableInboxCoalescingPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	dsn := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	if dsn == "" {
		t.Skip("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL not configured")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("T20 requires exact isolated database127.0.0.1:58999/remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	student, path := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	makeEvent := func() domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent {
		identity := uuid.NewString()
		e := domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{EventType: domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, StudentID: student, CorrelationID: path, CausationID: identity, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond), SchemaVersion: 1, Data: domain.PlanningStateChangedData{LearningPathID: path, PathVersion: 1, TriggerKind: "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE", TriggerIdentity: identity, Targets: []domain.HybridTargetRef{{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "t20.durable", Version: "1"}}}}
		e.EventID = domain.PlanningStateChangedEventID(student, path, e.Data.TriggerKind, identity)
		return e
	}
	first := makeEvent()
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	results := make(chan bool, 8)
	failures := make(chan error, 8)
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			created, e := store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, first)
			if e != nil {
				failures <- e
			}
			results <- created
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	close(results)
	close(failures)
	for e := range failures {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	created := 0
	for ok := range results {
		if ok {
			created++
		}
	}
	if created != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("concurrent duplicate produced%d inboxes", created)
	}
	changed := first
	changed.Data.PathVersion++
	if _, err = store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, changed); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("changed payload replay:%v", err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if _, err = store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, makeEvent()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	var n, generation int64
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*),max(generation) FROM hybrid_evaluation_work WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2`, student, path).Scan(&n, &generation); err != nil || n != 1 || generation != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("burstwork%d generation%d:%v", n, generation, err)
	}
	// Other retained test work is harmless; claim only after postponing our own work
	// is unnecessary in a root-exclusive dedicated DB. Loop past already claimed fixture work.
	work, found, err := store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found {
		t.Fatalf("claim:%v found%v", err, found)
	}
	if work.StudentID != student {
		t.Fatal("root must run inbox proof before production worker and with no other pending fixture")
	}
	if work.Generation != 4 || work.LatestEvent.Data.LearningPathID != path {
		t.Fatal("claim lost watermark/identity")
	}
	if _, found, err = store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute); err != nil || found {
		t.Fatalf("concurrent claim found%v:%v", found, err)
	}
	if _, err = store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, makeEvent()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, work, time.Now().Add(time.Hour)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next, found, err := store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now().UTC(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || next.Generation != 5 || next.ClaimToken == work.ClaimToken {
		t.Fatalf("new event during lease was lost:%#v %v", next, err)
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, work, time.Now()); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("expired token released newer claim")
	}
	if err = store.ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, next, time.Now().Add(24*time.Hour)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Lease expiration and restart use a fresh Store and never depend on process memory.
	third, found, err := store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now().Add(25*time.Hour), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	restarted := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	fourth, found, err := restarted.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now().Add(26*time.Hour), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || third.ClaimToken == fourth.ClaimToken {
		t.Fatalf("restart lease recovery:%v", err)
	}
	if err = restarted.ReleaseHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, fourth, time.Now().Add(48*time.Hour)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestT20HybridSnapshotCheckpointPostgres(t *testing.T) {
	dsn, file := os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_DATABASE_URL"), os.Getenv("PLANNER_T20_SNAPSHOT_FILE")
	if dsn == "" || file == "" {
		t.Skip("root owner snapshot fixture and isolated database not configured")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dsn)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_planner_integration_proof" {
		t.Fatal("exact isolated T20 database required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(file)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var snapshot domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &snapshot) != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid real owner snapshot")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	store := plannerpostgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	identity := uuid.NewString()
	event := domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{EventType: domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, StudentID: snapshot.StudentID, CorrelationID: snapshot.LearningPathID, CausationID: identity, OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond), SchemaVersion: 1, Data: domain.PlanningStateChangedData{LearningPathID: snapshot.LearningPathID, PathVersion: snapshot.Path.Version, TriggerKind: "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE", TriggerIdentity: identity, Targets: snapshot.RequestedTargets}}
	event.EventID = domain.PlanningStateChangedEventID(event.StudentID, event.Data.LearningPathID, event.Data.TriggerKind, identity)
	if _, err = store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, event); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	work, found, err := store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || work.StudentID != event.StudentID {
		t.Fatalf("claim %v", err)
	}
	newer := event
	newer.Data.TriggerIdentity = uuid.NewString()
	newer.CausationID = newer.Data.TriggerIdentity
	newer.EventID = domain.PlanningStateChangedEventID(newer.StudentID, newer.Data.LearningPathID, newer.Data.TriggerKind, newer.Data.TriggerIdentity)
	if _, err = store.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, newer); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	id, err := store.CheckpointHybridSnapshot(ctx, work, snapshot, domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	next, found, err := store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now(), time.Minute)
	if err != nil || !found || next.Generation != work.Generation+1 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint lost new event:%#v %v", next, err)
	}
	again, err := store.CheckpointHybridSnapshot(ctx, next, snapshot, domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion)
	if err != nil || again != id {
		t.Fatalf("same snapshot duplicate job:%s %s %v", id, again, err)
	}
	var count int
	if err = pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM hybrid_evaluation_job WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2 AND snapshot_ref=$3`, event.StudentID, event.Data.LearningPathID, snapshot.References.SnapshotRef).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("jobs%d:%v", count, err)
	}
	if _, err = store.CheckpointHybridSnapshot(ctx, work, snapshot, domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatal("old token checkpoint accepted")
	}
	if _, found, err = store.ClaimHybridEvaluationWork(ctx, time.Now(), time.Minute); err != nil || found {
		t.Fatalf("completed work still pending:%v", err)
	}
}
